# signoz_saved_views (Data Source)

Lists explorer saved views (`GET /api/v1/explorer/views`) with optional query filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Required/optional comments follow provider schema and SigNoz OpenAPI / Alertmanager where applicable.

data "signoz_saved_views" "logs" {
  source_page = "logs" # optional (list filter)
}

output "saved_view_count" {
  value = length(data.signoz_saved_views.logs.views) # read-only
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `category` (String) Optional filter passed to the list API as `category`. Default: omitted (no filter).
- `name` (String) Optional filter passed to the list API as `name`. Default: omitted (no filter).
- `source_page` (String) Optional filter passed to the list API as `sourcePage`. Default: omitted (no filter).

### Read-Only

- `views` (Attributes List) Saved views matching the optional filters. Read-only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--views))

<a id="nestedatt--views"></a>
### Nested Schema for `views`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Optional category label in the UI. Default: omitted (empty string).
- `composite_query` (String) JSON explorer query (`CompositeQuery` in query-service). Required. Must include `queryType` (typically `builder`) and `queries` with valid builder specs for the `source_page` signal.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was created. Read-only.
- `created_by` (String) Identifier of the user or service that created the object. Read-only.
- `extra_data` (String) Optional opaque JSON string used by the SigNoz UI for extra state. Default: omitted (empty string).
- `id` (String) SigNoz-assigned UUID. Read-only.
- `name` (String) Saved view name. Used for data source lookup when `id` is not set (with optional `source_page` filter).
- `source_page` (String) Explorer page this view belongs to. Valid values: `logs`, `traces`, `metrics` (SigNoz explorer tabs).
- `tags` (List of String) Optional list of tag strings. Default: omitted (no tags).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was last updated. Read-only.
- `updated_by` (String) Identifier of the user or service that last updated the object. Read-only.
